digest.component_or_area: Live external LLM provider matrix guard
propositions: Commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 renamed the openai qualifier to 'openai-chat' in the resolver and updated the unit-tier matrix gate but not the live external tier's credential map and provider comparisons.

The live test suite skips all LLM tests on the openai arm because _live_llm.py has no 'openai-chat' entry in _PROVIDER_KEY_ENV, causing configured_provider() to return 'openai-chat' which credential_present() cannot find.

test_provider_matrix_live.py:88 fails because it compares the resolved qualifier 'openai-chat' literally against REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER='openai' (the family name), producing a false-positive guard rejection.
The fix maps qualifier-to-family in _live_llm.py so configured_provider() returns the family name, making credential lookup, live_llm_ready(), and the arm-equality guard all agree.

The guard's intent (arm runs the provider it claims) is still satisfied after the fix; openai-chat and openai name the same provider family and the guard retains its ability to catch true cross-provider mismatches.
